RULES_INSPECTOR.WARNING_PATH_DEFAULT: {{path}} decides who can see or change {{schema}} records. A wrong default applies to every record {{service}} saves.
RULES_INSPECTOR.WARNING_PATH_RULE: {{path}} decides who can see or change {{schema}} records. A wrong rule applies to every record {{service}} saves.
